data.name: BOOMSTICKS
data.detailed_description:
GET THE BALL THROUGH THEIR HOOP

BOOMSTICKS is a two-team aerial ball game for 1v1 to 4v4. Every rider has a broom, 100 HP and one loaded shotgun shell.

A clean close-range blast kills. Firing starts a 2.5-second reload, so a missed shot leaves you exposed. The recoil kicks your own broom backwards. Use it to change direction, break away or throw yourself somewhere dangerous.

THE BALL STAYS IN PLAY

Carrying the ball takes your gun out of the fight. Hold the throw button to set the distance, lock a pass onto a teammate, then release.

Shotgun pellets are real projectiles. Hit a thrown ball from the side to bend its path. Blast it from behind to drive it through the hoop. Missed balls fall for a moment, then hang in the air under a recovery spell so the fight stays above the ruins.

STEAL THE UPPER HAND

Health and movement pickups float along risky routes. Horizontal wind tunnels fire riders across gaps. Blade traps and spikes punish anyone who stops watching the arena.

The Golden Switch moves through the map during regulation. Catch it and your one-shell boomstick becomes fully automatic for 20 seconds.

If the clock ends tied, both teams return to the start line. The Switch turns gold, breaks loose and starts running. First rider to catch it wins the match.

BUILT FOR THE REMATCH

Host Custom Games in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4. Change teams, tune the match and equip different riders, brooms and boomsticks.

BOOMSTICKS mixes chunky PSX models and pixel blood with fast third-person flight, loud hits and a cursed medieval arena hanging over a dead forest.

data.short_description: BOOMSTICKS is a 1v1 to 4v4 aerial bloodsport played on broomsticks with one shell in the chamber. Throw the ball through their hoop, kill riders at close range, redirect the ball with your pellets and hunt the Golden Switch when a tied match goes to overtime.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 7600 XT or equivalent
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
